description: This file defines the 'Authenticator' interface for the OFBiz framework, outlining methods for user authentication, user management, and configuration related to authentication plugins.

classes.name: Authenticator
classes.description: Interface for authentication mechanisms in OFBiz, requiring implementation of methods related to user authentication, synchronization, password updates, and configuration.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the authenticator with a LocalDispatcher instance.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication based on username, password, and whether it's for a service call.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user identified by username.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of this authenticator, lower values are run first.

methods.name: isUserSynchronized
methods.description: Checks if the user is synchronized back to OFBiz.

methods.name: isSingleAuthenticator
methods.description: Indicates if this is the only authenticator expected to handle users.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the authenticator is enabled.
